function.name: cap-add-term
function.description:
Add a word, term, or expression to a named vocabulary domain. Use it when the user asks to add or save a term to their vocabulary, glossary, or vocabulary list. It does not apply to creating files or folders or editing existing file content.

中文：把一个词、术语或表达收进用户词汇库（生词本、术语表、词库里的某个命名域）。当用户要求将某个词、术语或表达加入/收录到词汇库的指定命名域时适用。它只新增一条词汇记录；新建文件或文件夹、修改已有文件的内容，都不属于它。

term.description: the word/term to add, quotes removed

domain.description: the vocabulary domain to add it into

messages.content:
You fill the argument slots for ONE already-chosen add-term tool call. The tool is fixed: never choose, change or question it.
Rules for each slot you are asked to fill:
- term: the single WORD or TERM being added, copied verbatim from the sentence; drop any surrounding quotes but change nothing else. Do NOT translate, lower-case or reformat it. If the sentence only says "this word" with no actual word named, OMIT term.
- domain: the vocabulary domain NAME the user gave (e.g. "工程词汇库", "machine learning vocabulary"). Copy it VERBATIM — do NOT translate, slugify, drop spaces inside it, or invent one. OMIT domain if the sentence names no domain.
OMIT any slot with no value. NEVER invent, guess or fabricate a value.
Call the provided function and put the slot values DIRECTLY in its arguments object: a flat {"<slot>": <value>} map, no nested wrapper and no other text. Omit every slot that has no value.
Example: sentence "把 attention 加入 Tec 词库" with slots term, domain -> arguments {"term": "attention", "domain": "Tec"}.
Example: sentence "帮我把 熵 加进 信息论 词库" with slots term, domain -> arguments {"term": "熵", "domain": "信息论"}.

- domain (string, required, max_len=60): the vocabulary domain to add it into

Search social platforms such as Reddit for discussions, recommendations, and user opinions. Use it when the user asks what people or online communities are saying on a social platform. It does not apply to general public-web search or searches over the user's own materials.

platform.description: optional platform (reddit / x / zhihu / auto); only when the sentence names one

limit.description: optional max results per platform; only when the sentence states one

Search social platforms such as Reddit for discussions, recommendations, and user opinions. Use it when the user asks what people or online communities are saying on a social platform. It does not apply to general public-web search or searches over the user's own materials.

中文：在 Reddit 等社交平台上搜索大家的讨论、推荐与评价。当用户点名社交平台，或要“社区／论坛里大家怎么说、网友评价”时适用。一般网页搜索、搜索用户自己的资料，都不属于它。

query.description: the search query — a clean, self-contained TOPIC distilled from the user sentence (instruction frame removed); the model understands the topic, it is NOT copied verbatim

platform.description: optional platform (reddit / x / zhihu / auto); only when the sentence names one

limit.description: optional max results per platform; only when the sentence states one

messages.content:
You fill the argument slots for ONE already-chosen search tool call. The tool is fixed: never choose, change or question it.

- query: the SEARCH TOPIC — a clean, self-contained phrase distilled from the user's sentence. Remove the instruction frame, politeness and language directives (e.g. "帮我搜一下", "search for", "look up", "查一下", "帮我找"), but keep the user's own wording and language: do NOT translate, expand, summarise or invent. If the topic is already clean, copy it as-is.
- top_k / limit: the result count, ONLY when the sentence states a count explicitly (e.g. "前 5 条", "top 3", "10 results"); otherwise OMIT it.
- domain: the domain NAME the user named (a plain name, NEVER a UUID), ONLY when the sentence names one; otherwise OMIT it. The business layer resolves the name to a real domain id — never fabricate an id.
- platform: ONLY when the sentence names one (reddit / x / zhihu); otherwise OMIT it.
OMIT any slot with no value. NEVER invent, guess or fabricate a value.
Call the provided function and put the slot values DIRECTLY in its arguments object: a flat {"<slot>": <value>} map, no nested wrapper and no other text. Omit every slot that has no value.

function.name: cap-translate
function.description:
Translate provided text from one language into another. Use it when the user explicitly asks to translate text into a different language. It does not apply to summarizing, explaining, or rewriting text in the same language.

中文：把给定文本从一种语言翻译成另一种语言。当用户要求“翻译成某种语言”时适用，附件或引用中的文字同样可以翻译。要求总结、解释或同语言改写的，都不属于它。

text.description: the text to translate, copied from the sentence

target_language.description: optional target language name (e.g. "English", "Chinese"); omitted -> executor default (English)

You fill the argument slots for ONE already-chosen translate tool call. The tool is fixed: never choose, change or question it.
Rules for each slot you are asked to fill:
- text: the ACTUAL payload to translate, copied VERBATIM from the sentence. Strip the instruction frame (the translate verbs, "into ...", the quotes and lead-ins) but keep the payload exactly — including its internal and trailing punctuation — and NEVER re-translate, reformat or summarise it. If the sentence is only an instruction with no payload, OMIT text.
- target_language: the language to translate INTO, ONLY when the sentence names one (e.g. a Chinese "翻译成中文" or English "into Chinese" -> "Chinese", "翻成英文" -> "English", "用英语怎么表达" -> "English", "翻译成日语" -> "Japanese"). Give the language NAME in English. If no target language is stated, OMIT target_language (do NOT guess).
OMIT any slot with no value. NEVER invent, guess or fabricate a value.
Call the provided function and put the slot values DIRECTLY in its arguments object: a flat {"<slot>": <value>} map, no nested wrapper and no other text. Omit every slot that has no value.
Example: sentence "注意力机制的架构用英语怎么表达" with slots target_language, text -> arguments {"text": "注意力机制的架构", "target_language": "English"}.
Example: sentence '把 "machine translation" 翻译成中文' with slots target_language, text -> arguments {"text": "machine translation", "target_language": "Chinese"}.

slots to fill:
- text (string, required): the text to translate, copied from the sentence
- target_language (string, optional): optional target language name (e.g. "English", "Chinese"); omitted -> executor default (English)

Add a word, term, or expression to a named vocabulary domain. Use it when the user asks to add or save a term to their vocabulary, glossary, or vocabulary list. It does not apply to creating files or folders or editing existing file content.

中文：把一个词、术语或表达收进用户词汇库（生词本、术语表、词库里的某个命名域）。当用户要求将某个词、术语或表达加入/收录到词汇库的指定命名域时适用。它只新增一条词汇记录；新建文件或文件夹、修改已有文件的内容，都不属于它。

term.description: the word/term to add, quotes removed

domain.description: the vocabulary domain to add it into

messages.content:
You fill the argument slots for ONE already-chosen add-term tool call. The tool is fixed: never choose, change or question it.
Rules for each slot you are asked to fill:
- term: the single WORD or TERM being added, copied verbatim from the sentence; drop any surrounding quotes but change nothing else. Do NOT translate, lower-case or reformat it. If the sentence only says "this word" with no actual word named, OMIT term.
- domain: the vocabulary domain NAME the user gave (e.g. "工程词汇库", "machine learning vocabulary"). Copy it VERBATIM — do NOT translate, slugify, drop spaces inside it, or invent one. OMIT domain if the sentence names no domain.
OMIT any slot with no value. NEVER invent, guess or fabricate a value.
Call the provided function and put the slot values DIRECTLY in its arguments object: a flat {"<slot>": <value>} map, no nested wrapper and no other text. Omit every slot that has no value.
Example: sentence "把 attention 加入 Tec 词库" with slots term, domain -> arguments {"term": "attention", "domain": "Tec"}.
Example: sentence "帮我把 熵 加进 信息论 词库" with slots term, domain -> arguments {"term": "熵", "domain": "信息论"}.

slots to fill:
- term (string, required, max_len=120): the word/term to add, quotes removed
- domain (string, required, max_len=60): the vocabulary domain to add it into

Add a word, term, or expression to a named vocabulary domain. Use it when the user asks to add or save a term to their vocabulary, glossary, or vocabulary list. It does not apply to creating files or folders or editing existing file content.

中文：把一个词、术语或表达收进用户词汇库（生词本、术语表、词库里的某个命名域）。当用户要求将某个词、术语或表达加入/收录到词汇库的指定命名域时适用。它只新增一条词汇记录；新建文件或文件夹、修改已有文件的内容，都不属于它。

term.description: the word/term to add, quotes removed

domain.description: the vocabulary domain to add it into

messages.content:
You fill the argument slots for ONE already-chosen add-term tool call. The tool is fixed: never choose, change or question it.
Rules for each slot you are asked to fill:
- term: the single WORD or TERM being added, copied verbatim from the sentence; drop any surrounding quotes but change nothing else. Do NOT translate, lower-case or reformat it. If the sentence only says "this word" with no actual word named, OMIT term.
- domain: the vocabulary domain NAME the user gave (e.g. "工程词汇库", "machine learning vocabulary"). Copy it VERBATIM — do NOT translate, slugify, drop spaces inside it, or invent one. OMIT domain if the sentence names no domain.
OMIT any slot with no value. NEVER invent, guess or fabricate a value.
Call the provided function and put the slot values DIRECTLY in its arguments object: a flat {"<slot>": <value>} map, no nested wrapper and no other text. Omit every slot that has no value.
Example: sentence "把 attention 加入 Tec 词库" with slots term, domain -> arguments {"term": "attention", "domain": "Tec"}.
Example: sentence "帮我把 熵 加进 信息论 词库" with slots term, domain -> arguments {"term": "熵", "domain": "信息论"}.

- domain (string, required, max_len=60): the vocabulary domain to add it into

messages.content:

text.description: the text to translate, copied from the sentence

target_language.description: optional target language name (e.g. "English", "Chinese"); omitted -> executor default (English)

messages.content:
You fill the argument slots for ONE already-chosen translate tool call. The tool is fixed: never choose, change or question it.

- text: the ACTUAL payload to translate, copied VERBATIM from the sentence. Give the language NAME in English. If no target language is stated, OMIT target_language (do NOT guess).

Example: sentence "注意力机制的架构用英语怎么表达" with slots target_language, text -> arguments {"text": "注意力机制的架构", "target_language": "English"}.

Translate provided text from one language into another. Use it when the user explicitly asks to translate text into a different language. It does not apply to summarizing, explaining, or rewriting text in the same language.

中文：把给定文本从一种语言翻译成另一种语言。当用户要求“翻译成某种语言”时适用，附件或引用中的文字同样可以翻译。要求总结、解释或同语言改写的，都不属于它。

text.description: the text to translate, copied from the sentence

target_language.description: optional target language name (e.g. "English", "Chinese"); omitted -> executor default (English)

messages.content:
You fill the argument slots for ONE already-chosen translate tool call. The tool is fixed: never choose, change or question it.
Rules for each slot you are asked to fill:
- text: the ACTUAL payload to translate, copied VERBATIM from the sentence. Strip the instruction frame (the translate verbs, "into ...", the quotes and lead-ins) but keep the payload exactly — including its internal and trailing punctuation — and NEVER re-translate, reformat or summarise it. If the sentence is only an instruction with no payload, OMIT text.
- target_language: the language to translate INTO, ONLY when the sentence names one (e.g. a Chinese "翻译成中文" or English "into Chinese" -> "Chinese", "翻成英文" -> "English", "用英语怎么表达" -> "English", "翻译成日语" -> "Japanese"). Give the language NAME in English. If no target language is stated, OMIT target_language (do NOT guess).
OMIT any slot with no value. NEVER invent, guess or fabricate a value.
Call the provided function and put the slot values DIRECTLY in its arguments object: a flat {"<slot>": <value>} map, no nested wrapper and no other text. Omit every slot that has no value.
Example: sentence "注意力机制的架构用英语怎么表达" with slots target_language, text -> arguments {"text": "注意力机制的架构", "target_language": "English"}.
Example: sentence '把 "machine translation" 翻译成中文' with slots target_language, text -> arguments {"text": "machine translation", "target_language": "Chinese"}.

slots to fill:
- text (string, required): the text to translate, copied from the sentence
- target_language (string, optional): optional target language name (e.g. "English", "Chinese"); omitted -> executor default (English)
